provenance.source: accepted Plan 13 race-physics.mjs; in-memory identity topSpeed adapter and straight-segment geometry only
provenance.seedSet: existing 8-seed calibration set; all 72 input cells; these seeds are not held-out validation
provenance.changedParameter: straight length only; radius fixed at 20; identity rating-to-internal-speed mapping; sampled 8–12 clamp removed
provenance.fixedPhysics: All other Plan 13 constants unchanged, including maxSpeed=12 corner-target search bound, minSpeed setting (unused after clamp removal), acceleration, braking, turn law, weave/contact mechanics, event caps, and finish resolution.
provenance.passRule: Calibration pass requires median simulation finish in [17,23]s and late-or-unresolved attempts ≤5%; late means strictly >23s. Under-17 outcomes are allowed.
provenance.inputMatrix: 3 roster ratings × 2 production race/field cases × 2 stances × trial off/on × 3 rest factors
provenance.playback: Selected +2s highlight reported separately from simulated crossing time

20.runMix: equal weight across 72 cells: 3 tiers × 2 race/field inputs × 2 stances × 2 trial states × 3 rest factors

conservativeSeedBlockBootstrap95.note: No observed late-or-unresolved outcomes; bootstrap is degenerate. Use Wilson interval as an attempt-level bound.
